newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA-VIISURK TO MAKE 11.7 MLN KROON SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA-VIISURK TO MAKE 11.7 MLN KROON SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Viisnurk, one of the largest ski makers in the world, will organise an 11.7 million kroons share issue between May 12-26, the company said on Friday after its annual general shareholders' meeting.
The annual meeting in Parnu approved a proposal to raise the company's share capital by 11.7 million kroons with a 90,000 share issue with a nominal value of 10 kroons per share.
The new shares will be sold at 135 kroons, the company said in a statement. It did not say what the current value of its share capital was.
Present share holders have a pre-emptive purchase right in the new share issue, the statement added.
The meeting also decided to list the company on the secondary list of the Tallinn stock exchange.
The share issue will be organised by Hansa Investments.
Viiskurk's 1996 profit was 8.1 million kroons and its net turnover in 1996 was 154 million kroons. The company's forecast of 1997 is for a turnover of 185 kroons and a profit of 10 million kroons.
Besides skiis, Viisknurk also makes furniture and insulation products.
